meta.name: generate-report
meta.description: Save investigation findings to a markdown report file. Use after completing triage, enrichment, or investigation to create a permanent record. Generates timestamped files in ./reports/ directory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将调查结果保存为带时间戳的 Markdown 报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在调查后生成永久性报告文件
copy.tagline_en: Save investigation findings as timestamped Markdown reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create permanent report files after investigations

howto.what: 完成调查后，Claude 自动将结果保存为带时间戳的 Markdown 文件，存入 ./reports/ 文件夹。
howto.when: 在完成告警分类、情报扩充或事件调查后，需要生成永久记录时触发。

say.text: 保存本次告警分类报告，类型 alert_triage，后缀 case_1234。
保存威胁狩猎报告，类型 hunt_summary，后缀 APT29。

howto.what_en: After completing an investigation, Claude automatically saves findings as a timestamped Markdown file in ./reports/.
howto.when_en: Triggered after alert triage, IOC enrichment, or case investigation to create a permanent record.

say_en.text: Save this alert triage report, type alert_triage, suffix case_1234.
Save this IOC enrichment, type ioc_enrichment, suffix 198.51.100.10.
Save this hunt summary, type hunt_summary, suffix APT29.
